job: Browse a product's blog: the newest long read first, then every post filtered by kind and topic.
purpose: The blog index of Ember's public site: the newest long read large beside three more (posts featured, its head the page's h1), then every post as editorial rows without a date rail (kind, title, a longer summary, authors, a small frame), filtered by kind and topic, searched, paged eight at a time with the filters in the address, and the newsletter on the inverse ground.
useWhen: A product publishes posts on its own site.
Readers come for one kind of post or one topic, and share a filtered view.

avoidWhen.when: Releases, fixes and deprecations, newest first, for people who follow the product.
Reports, guides and templates people download.

sections.why: Shared with the product pages: the blog is part of the product site.
The newest long read large with its media, three more beside it; the section head is the page's h1.
Every post as editorial rows without the changelog's date rail: kind, title, summary, authors, a frame at the end; kind chips, a topic select, search and pages.
The blog's one action, the newsletter, in one field on the site's darkest ground.
After a list the reader looks for somewhere to go next.

states.name: filtered
states.how: ?kind=engineering&topic=latency&q=… in the address, or the chips, select and search; Back restores the last view

states.name: paged
states.how: ?page=2, or the page buttons; focus moves to the first post of the page

states.name: no results
states.how: a filter that matches nothing: fd-empty with Clear filters

states.name: sign-up invalid, busy, sent, subscribed
states.how: submit the newsletter form: data-state invalid, then busy, then sent (dana@quarry.dev: subscribed)

states.name: menu open
states.how: below 900px wide, the header's menu button opens the links as a sheet (data-state="open")
